p: the handle in the hole [kofina] of the hoe [mara] becomes loose [rafya],
one who sends a bill of divorce to his wife
The bill of divorce that I gave you,
it is void, … this … is hereby void.
it is void, then this bill of divorce is hereby void.
where he sent an agent to her,
The bill of divorce that I sent to you,
it is void, … this … is hereby void.
it is void, then this bill of divorce is hereby void.
once the bill of divorce had entered her possession,
he can no longer render it void,
would convene a court elsewhere and render … void
would convene a court elsewhere and render the bill of divorce void
that one should not do this,
for the betterment of the world.
does not teach: … He reached … him;
does not teach: He reached the agent after pursuing him;
g: ואין אנו אומרים שבמקרה כזה לצער את אשתו בלבד

p: Why do I … or … where he sent … agent after him?
Why do I need the mishna to state that the bill of divorce is void when he reached the agent, or in a case where he sent another agent after him?
the agency of the latter, … is not stronger than the agency of the former, … that … nullify
the agency of the latter, the second agent, is not stronger than the agency of the former, and that the latter agent cannot nullify
g: אינה חזקה שליחותו של האחרון יותר משליחותו של הראשון שיוכל זה האחרון לבטלנה

p: Why do I … his wife before
Why do I need the mishna to teach a case where a husband reached his wife before
when we don’t say … intends … to vex her
when we don’t say that he intends only to vex her
he certainly intends … to vex her,
he certainly intends only to vex her,
Why do I … Or where he sent an agent to her,
Why do I need the mishna to state: Or where he sent an agent to her,
he exerts … certainly intends … to vex her
he exerts himself for no reason, and the husband certainly intends only to vex her
g: טורח רק על דעת לצער אותה

p: once the bill of divorce had entered her possession,
he can no longer render it void, … Isn’t
he can no longer render it void, as the divorce had already taken effect. The Gemara asks: Isn’t
where he was going around searching for … from the beginning … to render it void … Lest you say:
where he was going around searching for the bill of divorce from the beginning in order to render it void before it reached his wife, once it enters her possession it is too late. Lest you say:
it has become clear retroactively that he rendered it void

w.6: no longer render it void … Isn’t
w.13: going around searching for … beginning … to render it void
w.19: has become clear … that he rendered it void

g: שהיה מחזר עליו, על הגט הזה מתחילה לבטלו

p: It is not a bill of divorce,
Is this to say that … Batel, is a … formulation that means: … Let it become void,
Is this to say that the formulation: Batel, is a prescriptive formulation that means: Let it become void,
But didn’t Rabba bar Aivu say
after the gift had entered his possession, … said:
after the gift had entered his possession, said:
This gift is rendered void; … Let it become void;
This gift is rendered void; or if he said: Let it become void;
his statement is effective, … Apparently, … Batel, means
his statement is effective, as these formulations indicate that he had never agreed to acquire the gift in the first place. Apparently, the formulation: Batel, means

w.3: Batel is a … formulation that means … Let it become void
